name: Charlotte
operatingHours: The LYNX Blue Line light rail runs ~4:40 AM–~1:30 AM daily (last trips ~2:00 AM), every ~10 min at rush hour, ~15–20 min midday and weekends and ~30 min late evenings and early Sunday. The CityLYNX Gold Line streetcar runs every ~30 min, 6:00 AM–~11:30 PM weekdays, 8:00 AM–~11:30 PM Saturdays and 8:00 AM–~10:30 PM Sundays.
fareInfo: $2.20 per Blue Line or local bus ride (2026), bought with the CATS-Pass app or at ticket machines on the light-rail platforms (proof-of-payment, keep your ticket); buses also take cash. A 1-day pass is $6.60 and a 7-day pass $30.80, and CATS-Pass caps your fares. The Gold Line streetcar is fare-free until further notice.

sights.name: NASCAR Hall of Fame
sights.note: Stock-car racing's shrine beside the convention center: Glory Road's banked track of historic cars, racing simulators and a pit-stop challenge.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, closed Tue (private groups only)

sights.name: Billy Graham Library
sights.note: Barn-shaped museum on the evangelist's life, with a talking-cow-led tour, his restored boyhood home and the memorial garden where he is buried. Free.
sights.hours: 9:30 AM–5:00 PM Mon–Sat (last tour 3:30 PM), closed Sun

sights.name: Discovery Place Science
sights.note: Hands-on science museum on North Tryon with a rainforest, aquariums, a maker space and a giant-screen theater; popular with families.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM Mon–Fri, 10:00 AM–4:30 PM Sat–Sun

sights.name: Freedom Park
sights.note: Dilworth's big green park around a lake, with a loop path, sports fields, a playground and a link onto the Little Sugar Creek Greenway.

sights.name: Sullenberger Aviation Museum
sights.note: Airport-side aviation museum built around US Airways Flight 1549, the 'Miracle on the Hudson' A320, plus cockpits you can sit in and a historic hangar.
sights.hours: 10:00 AM–4:30 PM Tue–Sat, noon–4:30 PM Sun, closed Mon

sights.name: Mint Museum Uptown
sights.note: Five-floor glass art museum on South Tryon focused on American and contemporary art, craft and design.
sights.hours: 11:00 AM–6:00 PM Tue–Sat (to 9:00 PM Wed & Fri), 1:00–5:00 PM Sun, closed Mon

sights.name: Belk Theater at Blumenthal Performing Arts Center
sights.note: Uptown's 2,100-seat main stage for touring Broadway shows, ballet and concerts, under a glowing crown sculpture.
sights.hours: Show nights; box office hours vary

sights.name: Bank of America Stadium
sights.note: The Carolina Panthers' and Charlotte FC's open-air stadium on the edge of Uptown, ringed by bronze panther statues.
sights.hours: NFL and MLS game days and events; guided tours on select dates

sights.name: Museum of Illusions Charlotte
sights.note: Interactive rooms of optical tricks, tilted spaces and mirror puzzles built for photos, in the Ally Charlotte Center on South Tryon.

sights.name: Truist Field
sights.note: Downtown ballpark of the Triple-A Charlotte Knights, with skyline views over the outfield beside Romare Bearden Park.
sights.hours: Knights home games ~Apr–Sep (mostly evenings); no games in the off-season

sights.name: Spectrum Center
sights.note: Uptown arena of the NBA's Charlotte Hornets and big-name concerts, right at the CTC/Arena light-rail stop.

sights.name: Wing Haven
sights.note: Walled Myers Park garden and bird sanctuary created by the Clarkson family, with brick paths, fountains and seasonal plant sales.

sights.name: ImaginOn: The Joe & Joan Martin Center
sights.note: Library branch and children's theater in one: a playful public library for kids and teens that also hosts Children's Theatre of Charlotte shows. Free.
sights.hours: 9:00 AM–8:00 PM Mon–Thu, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Fri–Sat, 1:00–5:00 PM Sun

sights.name: Fourth Ward
sights.note: Uptown's leafy Victorian residential quarter of restored 19th-century houses, a small park and the Old Settlers' Cemetery, good for a short walk.

sights.name: Romare Bearden Park
sights.note: Uptown park named for the Charlotte-born collagist, with gardens, a waterfall wall and lawns facing Truist Field.

sights.name: Optimist Hall
sights.note: Food hall in a restored 1890s gingham mill just north of Uptown, with two dozen local counters and a big communal seating hall.
sights.hours: 7:00 AM–9:00 PM Mon–Thu, 7:00 AM–10:00 PM Fri, 8:00 AM–10:00 PM Sat, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM Sun (vendors vary)

sights.name: Little Sugar Creek Greenway
sights.note: Paved creekside greenway running from Midtown past Freedom Park toward the south, good for an easy walk or bike ride close to Uptown.

sights.name: NoDa Brewing Company
sights.note: Big North Tryon taproom of one of Charlotte's best-known craft breweries, in the old Speas Vinegar plant on the edge of the NoDa arts district.
sights.hours: Taproom open daily, ~noon–10:00 PM (shorter hours early in the week)

railStations.name: Charlotte Amtrak Station
railStations.note: Charlotte's Amtrak station at 1914 North Tryon Street, ~2.5 km northeast of Uptown: Carolinian trains to Washington and New York, several daily Piedmont trains to Raleigh, and the overnight Crescent (New York–New Orleans). Not on the light-rail map: Parkwood and 25th Street Blue Line stops are ~0.5 km away as the crow flies, but the walk crosses rail lines, so most travellers take a taxi/rideshare (~10 min) to Uptown. The planned move to Gateway Station in Uptown has not happened yet.
railStations.hours: Station open 24 hours; trains from early morning to late evening plus the overnight Crescent.

airports.name: Charlotte Douglas International Airport
airports.transitNote: No rail link and not on the map. CATS Sprinter bus Route 5 runs from the terminal's lower level to the Charlotte Transportation Center (CTC/Arena Blue Line stop) in Uptown in ~25 min for the regular local fare, every ~15 min weekdays and ~20 min weekends; Route 60 links the airport with Tyvola Blue Line station. A taxi or rideshare to Uptown takes ~15–20 min.
airports.hours: Sprinter ~5:00 AM–~1:20 AM daily (from ~6:00 AM weekends); no overnight service.
